secrets.usageGuidePrefix.en: Create or link a secret here, then open an agent's Environment variables or a project's Env field. Add the env key the process expects, for example
secrets.usageGuidePrefix.zh-CN: 在此创建或关联密钥，然后打开智能体的环境变量或项目的 Env 字段。添加进程所需的环境变量键，例如

secrets.usageGuideResolution.en: Paperclip resolves the value server-side when the run starts and injects it as that env var. Project env applies to every task in the project and overrides agent env on matching keys.
secrets.usageGuideResolution.zh-CN: 运行开始时，Paperclip 会在服务端解析该值并注入为相应环境变量。项目 Env 适用于项目中的所有任务，并在键相同时覆盖智能体 Env。

secrets.usageGuideSelectVersion.en: , and select the stored secret version.
secrets.usageGuideSelectVersion.zh-CN: ，然后选择已存储的密钥版本。

secrets.userAccessEventsDescription.en: Access events show when a member-owned value is resolved. Secret values are never displayed.
secrets.userAccessEventsDescription.zh-CN: 访问事件会显示成员自有值何时被解析，但绝不会显示密钥值。

secrets.userDefinitionDescription.zh-CN: 按用户提供的密钥定义 {{key}}

secrets.userDefinitionNoValue.en: No value is stored on this admin row. Each member manages their own value under My secrets.
secrets.userDefinitionNoValue.zh-CN: 此管理行不存储任何值。每位成员在“我的密钥”中管理自己的值。

secrets.userOwnedValue.en: Each user provides and owns their own value
secrets.userOwnedValue.zh-CN: 每位用户提供并拥有自己的值

secrets.userProvidedSecretHelp.en: Every member supplies their own value under My secrets. Agents resolve the responsible user's value at runtime.
secrets.userProvidedSecretHelp.zh-CN: 每位成员在“我的密钥”中提供自己的值。智能体运行时会解析负责人对应的值。

secrets.userSecretKeyHelp.zh-CN: 请使用稳定的环境变量式键名。

secrets.userSecretKeyStable.en: The key cannot be changed after creation.

secrets.valuePlaceholder.zh-CN: 只保存一次，不会再次显示

secrets.valueProviderHelp.en: Company stores one shared value. Each user lets every member supply their own value under My secrets.
secrets.valueProviderHelp.zh-CN: “公司”存储一个共享值；“每位用户”允许所有成员在“我的密钥”中提供自己的值。
